home.title: Yoyo — rent things from people nearby
home.description: Borrow what you need for a day or a week from people near you, and earn from the things you rarely use. Clear rules, a contract before paying and a protected deposit.

marquee.four: Every listing checked by a person

what.title: Rent. Lend. Repeat.
what.lead: Yoyo is a marketplace where people rent things to each other. The drill you need once a year, a tent for one weekend, a console for a party night: someone nearby already has it, and it is gathering dust on a shelf.

rent.title: Rent instead of buying
rent.body: Pay only for the days you use it. Nothing to store, nothing to dust, no purchase to regret.

lend.title: Earn from your shelf
lend.body: List the things you rarely use, set your price and deposit, and decide who you trust them to.

back.title: It comes back
back.body: Every rental ends with the item home again. That is the whole idea behind the name.

find.title: Find it
find.body: Look for what you need and mark your days on the calendar.

ask.title: Ask the owner
ask.body: Send a request. The owner has 24 hours to accept it.

sign.title: Sign, then pay
sign.body: You both sign a short rental contract, then you pay the rent and the deposit.

meet.title: Meet and use it
meet.body: Pick the item up in person, both mark the handover, and it is yours for those days.

return.title: Bring it back
return.body: Once the owner confirms all is well, the whole deposit comes back to you.

list.title: List it
list.body: Photos, a fair price per day, a deposit and your rules. We check every listing before it goes live.

choose.title: Choose who rents
choose.body: Requests come to you, and you accept the ones that suit you.

handover.title: Hand it over
handover.body: Meet up, photograph the item's condition and mark the handover.

paid.title: Get paid
paid.body: The rent is yours as soon as the handover is confirmed.

check.title: Check and close
check.body: When it is back, check it within 48 hours: all good, or report damage.

deposit.title: A deposit with one clear rule
deposit.body: The deposit is frozen during the rental. All fine: it goes back to the renter in full. Damage the renter accepts: it goes to the owner. If they disagree, our team looks at the photos and the chat and decides.

contract.title: A contract before any money
contract.body: Dates, price, deposit and rules go into a rental contract that both sides sign before anyone pays.

moderation.title: Every listing checked
moderation.body: A person reviews each listing before it appears on the site. You can report a listing, a message or a user at any time.

reviews.title: Reviews from real deals only
reviews.body: Only people who actually rented from each other can leave a review, within 14 days of the deal.

categories.title: What you can rent
categories.lead: These are the categories on Yoyo today. You pick one of them when you list an item.

final.lead: List it in a few minutes, or create an account and rent your first thing this weekend.
